item.title: Sault man accused of repeated nuisance 911 calls
item.description: A man made repeated nuisance calls to 911 last Friday, police say. The calls started at about 6:30 a.m. A suspect was found approximately two hours later. Aiden McCall, 20, was charged with mischief and failure to comply with release order. He was held in custody pending a bail hearing.

item.title: Province backs junior mining efforts north of Sault
item.description: Two mining companies active north of Sault Ste. Marie are getting funding from the Ontario Junior Exploration Program. Sterling Metals, searching for copper in Batchawana Bay, is receiving $215,000, while RPX Gold is being backed with $200,000 in support, a release says. item.title: Ferlaino speaks Thursday at Algoma University
item.description: An artist describes how she uses music, work and philanthropy to help systemically excluded voices in a talk Thursday at Algoma University. Vanessa Ferlaino, a sessional lecturer at the post-secondary institution, speaks at 6 p.m. at Arthur A. Wishart Library, a release says. Register at vanessaferlaino.com/speakerseries. Donations accepted to help Children of Shingwauk Alumni Association.
